com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Replace a load's truck and odometer details. Optional values left out are cleared; an omitted empty-distance override may still be derived by IPP. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes. Preview only; nothing is applied until you confirm.
examples: For our selected fictional practice load, preview replacing vehicle details with truck DEMO-TRUCK, starting odometer 10000 km, closing odometer 10400 km and empty distance 50 km. Show the complete replacement and wait for my confirmation.

annotations.title: Preview: Record a load's truck and km

description: Prepare replacing the truck/odometer record. Omitted optional vehicle fields are cleared; empty km can remain derived. Requires confirmation. This returns an exact preview and a five-minute confirmation token; it does not apply the change.
